name: the-correct-font
why: Opens on eighty years of law binders falling on Wishonia and "They are not designed to prevent wrongdoing"; the weapons factory is refused a permit to blow up a town only for its font, form and state, fixes them and nukes the town, and the same form to cure disease has to be approved, with a gold star.

name: prison-not-a-fine
why: Hooks on "The one rule your species enforces seriously" as one foreign coin drops a cage, shows two identical lobbyists where only the flag in the hat decides FINE or PRISON, and pays off when the world leaders dive under the table from the 1% Treaty and the fish signs it.

name: be-tedious
why: "Nobody martyrs the boring": the mob falls asleep at the accountant's stake while Socrates and Joan of Arc get the full treatment, and the bearded prosecutors wake to a world of tomorrow where a politician reaching for a patient's medicine sees the camera's red light.
